Stop.description:
Where a run stops: `through` a phase does its work and stops before
leaving it; `until` a phase moves into it and stops before its work.

through.description: The phase to stop in, after its work.

until.description: The phase to stop at, before its work.

description:
`changes/run/v1`: one run of an agent on a change that `changes.run`
started, which lets the cost of each flow be measured.

It lives at `/changes/<name>/runs/<stamp>`, stamped when the run
started.

budget_usd.description: The budget the run's brief gave the agent, in US dollars.

cost_usd.description: What the agent reported it cost, in US dollars.

duration_ms.description: How long the agent reported it ran, in milliseconds.

ended.description: When the agent exited or was stopped.

exit.description:
The agent's exit status; left out when it was stopped or ended on a
signal.

flow.description: The name of the flow the change followed.

phase.description: The phase the change stood in when the run ended.

program.description:
The file name of the program the run started, its `argv[0]` without
its path, when that name is a slug; never its arguments.

sandbox.description: Whether the agent ran in a sandbox.

stop.description: Where the run was told to stop.

title: RunRecord
